name: Sylindra Starweave in Dolanaar offers and takes back Path to Ascension: Novice Rider
contract: Reports #12211 and #12282: a Draenei at Dolanaar's riding trainer can learn Novice Riding but is never offered
the Novice Rider quest, and a quest started from the Path to Ascension book cannot be turned in to her.
Sylindra Starweave 449169 <Traveling Riding Trainer> teaches Novice Riding 33379 like Garion Hunter 97921 in
Goldshire, who offers and ends the Alliance quests 4420430, 4420432, 4420433, 4420436 and 4420439.
Expected: Sylindra shows a Draenei the available quest marker (8) and lists Draenei quest 4420439; a rider
who knows Novice Riding gets its credit on accepting (also with CoA.MaxRidingFromStart, which grants riding
at login), she then shows the turn-in marker (10), and the turn-in gives the Draenei starter mount 29744.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: Sylindra offers the Draenei a quest
Her quest menu lists the Draenei Novice Rider quest
Knowing Novice Riding completes the objective
DISCRIMINATING: Sylindra takes the completed quest back
The turn-in gives the Draenei starter mount
